blocks.content: Let's start by improving the overall layout and styling of your game!
You'll center everything on the page, add a nice background, and make the screens look more polished.

items: Add comprehensive styling for the game layout. Style the body element to center content and add a background.
Add styling for all three screens (#start-screen, #play-screen, #end-screen) with text alignment, padding, and backgrounds.
Style all button elements with padding, border-radius, background color, cursor pointer, and a hover effect.
